title: Intent Analysis - FRR
problemAndGoalSummary: The user submitted only a greeting ('ola') with no technical networking query, protocol references, device labels, or troubleshooting details. No FRR configuration, diagnostic issue, or conceptual question was stated.

executionPipeline.1: Acknowledge the greeting and wait for a specific technical inquiry regarding routing, switching, or FRR configuration.
executionPipeline.2: Prompt the user to specify the target protocol(s) (e.g., BGP, OSPF, IS-IS), device labels, and the exact nature of the issue or question.
